svg.title: 3C quality gates, grouped by when they fire and by who enforces them
svg.desc: While editing, the path guard hook blocks and the post-edit boundary check hook advises without blocking. While writing, the skill redacts secrets from the plan and the CLI refuses a test file, PR body or handover that carries one, and the skill writes a failing test before the code. At commit, the commit gate hook blocks by default; 3c bypass skips one commit with a reason and is logged. Before the PR, the skill stops on critical or major /3c-review findings, on a failing verify gate, and on a blocking review board verdict after one fix cycle. At ship, the skill asks a person to confirm the branch and the PR and never merges on its own.
